LanguageData.Mugirl.Lance.PointCharge.Label: Point charge
LanguageData.Mugirl.Lance.PointCharge.Desc: Charge a distant hostile target. Damage is based on the lance's current durability, then the lance loses durability and the survivor is stunned.
LanguageData.Mugirl.Lance.LineCharge.Label: Line charge
LanguageData.Mugirl.Lance.LineCharge.Desc: Charge a distant hostile target, striking and stunning each hostile pawn passed. A mounted rider also attacks those targets.
LanguageData.Mugirl.Lance.InvalidTarget: Select a living hostile pawn beyond the minimum charge distance.
LanguageData.Mugirl.Weapon.MugirlOnly: Only a Mugirl can safely equip this weapon.
